# LIBERO

[Home](../../../README.md) · [Documentation](../../README.md) · [All experiments](../../experiments/README.md)

Four manipulation suites cover Spatial, Object, Goal, and Long (libero_10). Our independently trained policy is evaluated on 40 tasks, with 50 episodes each.

[Official benchmark](https://github.com/Lifelong-Robot-Learning/LIBERO)
